subject: Re: International payout — multi-entity payee reference mapping & intermediary fee ownership
participants_external: andre.kovacs@brightmeds.com (André Kovács, Head of Finance, BrightMeds Ltd.)
messages:
From: André Kovács <andre.kovacs@brightmeds.com>

Cc: treasury@firstbank-eu.com
Date: 2028-07-30T07:12:00-04:00
Subject: New payout batch — multi-entity payee reference / intermediary fees

Vanessa,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. We have a mix of BrightMeds entities being paid from one centralized receivable (BrightMeds Holdings Ltd.). Our treasury team asked for clear routing so beneficiary references show the ultimate legal entity on the beneficiary line (so our ERP can auto-match).

Two questions that came up:
- Is Redwood able to send a distinct beneficiary reference and beneficiary name that differs from the ultimate "credit to" account label?
- If an intermediary bank deducts an intermediary fee (cover vs beneficiary-paid), what conventions do you want on the invoice/settlement memo so we align accounting (i.e., show fees as a separate line vs netting to settlement amount)?

I attached our preferred wire template — column "payee_entity_code" is what we want mapped to the beneficiary reference. If you could confirm field mapping and whether FirstBank (our payrail) can be requested to tag the nostro with a branch identifier (they mentioned "nostro tagging"), that would help.

Appreciate a quick reply — we have a cut-off Friday 15:00 BST for August payroll.

Best,
André Kovács
Head of Finance, BrightMeds Ltd.
andre.kovacs@brightmeds.com
+44 7712 345678

Attachment: wire_template_brightmeds.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: André Kovács <andre.kovacs@brightmeds.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, treasury@firstbank-eu.com
Date: 2028-07-30T09:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: New payout batch — multi-entity payee reference / intermediary fees

André — thanks, and appreciated the template. Quick answers up front and then a short ask for operations mapping: 

Summary answers:
- Yes — we can send a beneficiary reference (free text, up to 140 chars) independent of the beneficiary name. We map your "payee_entity_code" to the beneficiary reference field in the outbound MT/ISO message.
- Intermediary fees: Redwood will not net intermediary fees on behalf of the customer unless explicitly requested. Default behavior is to instruct the beneficiary to be paid gross and allow any intermediary deduction ("BEN vs SHA vs OUR" conventions depend on sending bank). For accounting clarity we recommend: invoice shows gross amount + anticipated intermediary fee estimate as separate line item (we can include the estimated fee band), and final settlement reconciliation will include actual deducted amount.

Operational asks: 
1) Confirm the exact payee_entity_code values you will send — we need them to set up matching rules in our payout mapper.
2) Please confirm which entities should receive the "credit to" ledger tag in our settlement report (you can provide legal entity ID).
3) Do you want Redwood to request FirstBank to include a nostro branch tag? We can send the request, but FirstBank may treat it as "advice only" depending on their rails.

I cc'd Laura (settlements) and Marissa (collections ops) to map the template to our payout schema. We'll aim to have a draft mapping for you by EOD tomorrow.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: nostro_tagging_sample.pdf (PDF, 8KB)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, André Kovács <andre.kovacs@brightmeds.com>
Cc: treasury@firstbank-eu.com
Date: 2028-07-30T13:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: New payout batch — multi-entity payee reference / intermediary fees

André / Vanessa — short operational note from settlements team: 

We reviewed the template. We can map the following: 
- payee_entity_code -> Beneficiary Reference (ISO field 70)
- payee_legal_name -> Beneficiary Name (field 59)
- payee_account -> Beneficiary Account (field 59a)

Intermediary fees and treatment: 
- Default instruction will be SHA (shared). If BrightMeds requires OUR to guarantee beneficiary receives gross, we need a signed funding preclear (Redwood will route + fund the OUR instruction and absorb a small fee for guaranteed settlement).
- If intermediaries deduct, our reconciliation file will include a separate column "intermediary_deductions" with currency and amount if the correspondent provides it. Not all correspondents return deduction details.

Nostro tagging: we can request FirstBank to include branch identifier in the nostro tag (e.g., "NOSTRO:FB-LON-22"). FirstBank has confirmed they will forward the request but cannot guarantee the downstream correspondent will preserve it. We suggest doing both: request tagging and include payee_entity_code in the beneficiary reference so your ERP still matches if tagging is lost.

Action items for BrightMeds (André):
- Send final mapping CSV with payee_entity_code values and legal entity IDs by EOD tomorrow (2028-07-31 16:00 BST).
- Confirm whether you'd prefer OUR for payroll runs (this requires a pre-funding authorization).

I will add this to our internal settlement runbook for your account.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Settlements Analyst, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: treasury@firstbank-eu.com <treasury@firstbank-eu.com>

Date: 2028-07-31T09:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: New payout batch — multi-entity payee reference / intermediary fees

Hi all,

FirstBank operations — quick confirmation: we can include a nostro branch tag on outbound messages when requested by the sender. Operational notes: 
- Tagging is advisory; downstream correspondents may not preserve tag.
- OUR instructions (guaranteed beneficiary gross) will require BrightMeds to pre-fund the payment file or Redwood to fund on your behalf.
- Intermediary deduction details: we will pass along deduction amounts whenever our correspondents return that information, otherwise deduction appears as a net received amount.

If Redwood sends the mapping request with the header "INCLUDE-NOSTRO-REF: FB-LON-22" we will add the tag for the run. Please confirm the run id (and attach the file) when sending.

Regards,
FirstBank Treasury Operations
treasury@firstbank-eu.com
